```{r} 
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

source("feature_engineering_functions.R")
training_data <- read.csv("training_data.csv")

poisson_formula <- Goals ~ DSTF + TeamRankCategory + HomeAway + opp_defence_score + 
    attack_score + DCS + DSF + DYF + OpponentRankCategory + DLF
# formula chosen in 02 Feature selection 

beta_grid <- seq(0.05, 1, by = 0.01)


# Build a function which converts predicted goals into match outcomes and then calculates the predicted and actual league tables
season_table <- function(df, beta = NULL, method = c("beta", "round")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)

  mp <- df %>%
    select(match_id, HomeAway, Team, Goals, predicted_goals) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = HomeAway,
                values_from = c(Team, Goals, predicted_goals)) %>%
    mutate(gd = predicted_goals_Home - predicted_goals_Away)
  # store the difference in prediction for every match
  
  if (method == "beta") {
    mp <- mp %>% mutate(
      pred_res = case_when(abs(gd) <= beta ~ "D", gd > beta ~ "H", TRUE ~ "A"))
  # use beta as a threshold determining the outcome of the match based on the difference in predictions
    
  } else {
    rh <- round(mp$predicted_goals_Home)
    ra <- round(mp$predicted_goals_Away)
    mp$pred_res <- case_when(rh > ra ~ "H", rh < ra ~ "A", TRUE ~ "D")
  # the round method just rounds the goals and then the outcome is determined from the rounded values
  }
  
  
  mp <- mp %>% mutate(
    act_res = case_when(Goals_Home > Goals_Away ~ "H",
                        Goals_Home < Goals_Away ~ "A", TRUE ~ "D"))
  # this stores the actual results 

  pts <- function(res, side) case_when(res == side ~ 3, res == "D" ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0)
  # calculates points from outcomes

  tab <- bind_rows(
    mp %>% transmute(Team = Team_Home,
                     pred_pts = pts(pred_res, "H"), act_pts = pts(act_res, "H"),
                     pred_gd = gd, act_gd = Goals_Home - Goals_Away,
                     act_gf = Goals_Home),
    mp %>% transmute(Team = Team_Away,
                     pred_pts = pts(pred_res, "A"), act_pts = pts(act_res, "A"),
                     pred_gd = -gd, act_gd = Goals_Away - Goals_Home,
                     act_gf = Goals_Away)
    # stores predicted and actual points and predicted and actual goal difference
    
  ) %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(pred_pts), desc(pred_gd), Team) %>%
    mutate(pred_rank = row_number()) %>%
    arrange(desc(act_pts), desc(act_gd), desc(act_gf), Team) %>%
    mutate(act_rank = row_number()) %>%
    arrange(Team)
  
  # sum up all the predicted and actual results for every team 
  list(tab = tab, mp = mp)
}


score_table <- function(st, season, method, beta = NA_real_) {
  tibble(
    Season    = season,
    method    = method,
    Beta      = beta,
    rank_mse  = mean((st$tab$pred_rank - st$tab$act_rank)^2),
    spearman  = cor(st$tab$pred_rank, st$tab$act_rank, method = "spearman"),
    pred_draw = mean(st$mp$pred_res == "D"),
    act_draw  = mean(st$mp$act_res == "D")
  )
}
# this makes a function analysing the quality of each method

# Expanding-window cross-validation to compare rounding and beta thresholds:
beta_cv <- function(training_data, poisson_formula, beta_grid, min_train = 1) { # value of min_train sets the first validation year. Here, as 2015/16
  seasons <- training_data %>%
    distinct(Year) %>%
    mutate(s = as.integer(substr(Year, 1, 4))) %>% # extracts the starting year from labels
    arrange(s) %>% pull(Year)
  # arrange converts years as a number so that seasons can be sorted chronologically
  # pull(year) extracts the season labels as a vector.

  map_dfr((min_train + 1):length(seasons), function(i) {
    train_fold <- training_data %>% filter(Year %in% seasons[1:(i - 1)])
    valid_fold <- training_data %>% filter(Year == seasons[i])
  # separating training validation and training data
  # the training fold contains all seasons before the current validation season
  # the validating fold contains a single season
    
    m <- glm(poisson_formula, data = train_fold,
             family = stats::poisson(link = "log"))
    valid_fold <- valid_fold %>%
      mutate(predicted_goals = predict(m, newdata = valid_fold, type = "response"))
  # poisson is trained on the training fold
    

    bind_rows(
      # rounding: no parameter to tune
      score_table(season_table(valid_fold, method = "round"),
                  seasons[i], "round"),
      # every beta on the grid
      map_dfr(beta_grid, function(b)
        score_table(season_table(valid_fold, beta = b, method = "beta"),
                    seasons[i], "beta_grid", b))
    )
  })
}

all_results   <- beta_cv(training_data, poisson_formula, beta_grid)
beta_results  <- all_results %>% filter(method == "beta_grid")
round_results <- all_results %>% filter(method == "round")
```
```{r}
seasons_v <- unique(beta_results$Season)

# best beta per season: "oracle"
oracle <- beta_results %>%
  group_by(Season) %>%
  slice_min(rank_mse, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% # selects the row with smallest MSE
  ungroup() %>% mutate(method = "beta (oracle)")

# beta chosen using only earlier validated seasons
fair <- map_dfr(2:length(seasons_v), function(j) {
  b <- beta_results %>%
    filter(Season %in% seasons_v[1:(j - 1)]) %>%
    group_by(Beta) %>%
    summarise(m = mean(rank_mse), .groups = "drop") %>%
    slice_min(m, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% pull(Beta) # selects the row with smallest MSE
  beta_results %>%
    filter(Season == seasons_v[j], Beta == b) %>%
    mutate(method = "beta (chosen on earlier seasons)")
})

comparison <- bind_rows(oracle, fair, round_results %>% mutate(method = "rounding"))

# Summary on the seasons where all three exist (drops the first season)
common <- fair$Season
comparison %>%
  filter(Season %in% common) %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarise(mean_rank_mse = mean(rank_mse), sd_rank_mse = sd(rank_mse),
            mean_spearman = mean(spearman), sd_spearman = sd(spearman),
            mean_pred_draw = mean(pred_draw), mean_act_draw = mean(act_draw),
            .groups = "drop")

# Season by season
comparison %>%
  filter(Season %in% common) %>%
  select(Season, method, Beta, rank_mse, spearman, pred_draw) %>%
  arrange(Season, method)

# Plots
ggplot(comparison %>% filter(Season %in% common),
       aes(Season, rank_mse, colour = method, group = method)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() + labs(y = "Rank MSE")

ggplot(comparison %>% filter(Season %in% common),
       aes(Season, spearman, colour = method, group = method)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() + labs(y = "Spearman")

# Rank MSE vs beta, with rounding as a horizontal reference
beta_results %>%
  group_by(Beta) %>% summarise(mean_rank_mse = mean(rank_mse), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(Beta, mean_rank_mse)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(round_results$rank_mse[round_results$Season %in% common]),
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  labs(y = "Mean rank MSE", caption = "Dashed red = rounding")
```

```{r}
oracle %>%
  summarise(
    mean_beta     = mean(Beta),
    sd_beta       = sd(Beta),
    min_beta      = min(Beta),
    max_beta      = max(Beta),
    mean_rank_mse = mean(rank_mse),
    mean_spearman = mean(spearman)
  )
```
The mean beta value is unreliable due to its high standard deviation.
